records.title: Programa de Becas de Cooperacion Sur-Sur - Republica de Chile 2027 (AGCID)

validation.notes: www.agcid.gob.cl is the official domain of Agencia Chilena de Cooperacion Internacional para el Desarrollo (AGCID), the awarding body named in the record title and official_source, and it is the record's own catalogue_url. Verified HTTP 200, Content-Type image/png, 226x135 px, 7281 bytes. Rendered and inspected visually: 'agcidChile' wordmark with the Chilean star motif, subtitle 'Cooperacion Chilena para el Desarrollo' and 'MINISTERIO DE RELACIONES EXTERIORES' - i.e. unambiguously the AGCID institutional logo, not the unrelated AGCI agency. CAVEAT driving MEDIUM: the filename says 'logo_agci' - a CMS copy/paste misnomer on AGCID's own site (the page's alt attribute is also mislabelled 'logo agci'). The same site also serves /images/banners/logo_agcid_35.webp (303x108), whose filename is correct but which the origin server returns with Content-Type 'audio/unknown', so it risks failing to render in strict pipelines; the PNG was chosen for reliable rendering. Identity is proven by the domain and by visual inspection, not by the filename.

source.publisher: Agencia Chilena de Cooperacion Internacional para el Desarrollo (AGCID), Government of Chile

validation.notes: ptdf.gov.ng is the Petroleum Technology Development Fund's own official domain. Verified HTTP 200, Content-Type image/png, 225x225 px, 99230 bytes.
